items.summary: CRO disposition: retain no new proposals this cycle. The strongest opportunities are a control-plane reconciliation capability and coverage-aware AI-cost reporting, but delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 39 improvements await measurement, and 21 requests have failed. Preserve them as deferred product opportunities; do not create duplicate queue work, telemetry, research, or implementation requests. Revisit after the canonical saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case releases capacity.

Deferred CRO product opportunity: prototype a read-only work-reconciliation view linking each approved proposal to exactly one request, blocker, or closure, with deduplication, site-overlap, active-slot, failure-repair, rollback, and measurement states. Evidence: 105 approved proposals lack execution requests and approved-proposal execution is 64%. Smallest reversible prototype is a read-only report over existing records; metric is approved proposals with a linked request or explicit disposition; learn within one delivery cycle after capacity clears.

Deferred CRO monetization opportunity: coverage-aware AI usage reporting that distinguishes observed cost from missing coverage and prevents unsupported ROI claims. Evidence: AI usage covers 4 of 38 expected sites, with $2.2785467 observed cost and partial attribution. Smallest reversible prototype is a read-only summary using existing records; metric is AI-usage decisions carrying explicit coverage and attribution status; learn within one reporting cycle after capacity clears.
